# IContent

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Content` · interface

```csharp
public interface IContent : IDisposable
```

Defines the contract for content types that are loaded and cached by the [`ContentService`](ContentService.md), which owns them, since everyone who loads a key shares one object: release them with [`ContentService.UnloadAsync`](ContentService.md#unloadasync). Extends `IDisposable` for the content service to release resources with, and exposes [`IsDisposed`](#isdisposed) so the cache can detect and evict stale entries.
